title: Post-adoption TimeSample mutation can prevent source expiry
description: Post-fix correctness review: tracker retains the caller-visible TimeSample and expiry rereads observed_monotonic. object.__setattr__ after adoption can continually move the observation time and prevent idle expiry; issuer snapshot is checked only at adoption. Store detached trusted authoritative state or revalidate the issuer snapshot on every read/transition. Mutation after adoption must not change validity/status.
